thread:
Alex Chen: Heads up — new SI onboarding cohort kicks off next Wed (May 10). Need greenlight on three things: hardware sandbox kit shipment, certification proctoring flow, and cloud marketplace listing sync. TL;DR: 30 SI seats, 15 physical kits.
Maria Gomez: Do we have ETA for the remaining kits? last I saw 7 pending config.
Kevin Patel: 7 pending, correct. 10 already imaged and staged at the lab. Shipping manifest in the tracker: https://docs.internal/si-kits-shipping (sheet: ‘May-cohort’).
Julia Lee: For cert proctoring — are we doing recorded remote proctoring or live proctors? live proctors cost more but better fraud prevention.
Alex Chen: Preference is live for this first cohort, we can relax later. Also need to confirm proctor availability across PST/CEST windows.
Kevin Patel: I can double-check hardware serials and zip codes today. Also need to confirm whether kits include the new NVMe recovery image (v2.1).
Maria Gomez: We should include a small quickstart lab that uses both Hosted API and Dedicated (to show routing). Idea: a 30-min guided lab with checkpoints and a short quiz. I can draft learning objectives.
Julia Lee: +1. For the lab environment we need a pre-provisioned sandbox project per SI with the demo dataset and an ingress rule to allow their IP ranges. Ops, is that doable?
Kevin Patel: Ops confirmed we can spin ephemeral GCP projects via the provisioning script. Example command we used last sprint:
```
./provision_sandbox.sh --project-prefix si-cohort-0524 --region us-central1 --kits 15
```
Make sure the service account has roles/compute.admin and roles/storage.objectViewer.
OnboardBot: Reminder: Booked Zoom rooms for live proctoring on May 10-12, two concurrent sessions per day. Links will be posted to the cohort calendar.
Alex Chen: Who wants to own marketplace listing sync (SKU mapping, co-branded description, partner logos)? This needs legal review too.
Maria Gomez: I’ll take marketplace listing + partner collateral. Will loop in legal for logo T&Cs. Target: draft by EOD Friday.
Kevin Patel: I’ll finish kit imaging and upload the final manifest with serials + photos by EOD today. I’ll also annotate which kits have v2.1 image.
Julia Lee: I’ll own the proctor rota and the hands-on lab deck. Will pair with Maria on learning objectives so the quiz matches the cert pass criteria.
Alex Chen: Perfect — owners: Maria (marketplace + collateral), Kevin (kits + manifest), Julia (proctor rota + lab). Deadline: Friday 18:00 PT for all deliverables so we can get legal and SRE sign-off over the weekend.
Kevin Patel: Quick question — do we want to gate certification on a pass in the lab quiz or also require a short live troubleshooting task during the proctored session?
Maria Gomez: Let’s require both: quiz pass + 1 live troubleshooting task. Keeps it practical.
Julia Lee: Agreed. I’ll draft a 10-min troubleshooting scenario (networking + deployment rollback).
Alex Chen: Awesome. Also reminder to update the SI onboarding playbook with the new kit SKU and exam flow — I’ll handle that once I get everyone’s final notes.
OnboardBot: Action items created: #SI-COHORT-0524:kits, #SI-COHORT-0524:marketplace, #SI-COHORT-0524:proctoring. Owners assigned according to thread.
Maria Gomez: linking a strawman checklist for anyone who wants to copy: https://docs.internal/si-onboard-checklist/strawman
Alex Chen: Thanks all — this is tight but doable. Ping me if anything slips, otherwise we review Friday 16:00 PT in the partnerships channel (quick stand). :thumbsup:
